subject: Re: QuantumLift — Redwood + AWS co-sell / staggered marketplace demo
content:
From: Elena Torres <elena@quantumlift.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
Cc: AWS SI - Partner Ops <aws-partner-coordinator@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Redwood x QuantumLift — co-sell listing + demo request

Mina / Redwood team,

Thanks for the intro call last week. QuantumLift would love to do a co-sell listing demo focused on three items: marketplace listing walkthrough, live inference on a customer-like workload, and a short ops Q&A for our SI and AWS partners. The goal is to have Redwood engineers + our SI (Tom Sanders) in the room so we can validate the run-of-show and integration notes before public listing.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Jul 25, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Jul 26, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Jul 27, 08:30–09:30 (early EMEA-friendly)

Attendees (high level): QuantumLift product + sales, Redwood Sales/Partnerships, AWS SI rep. I attached a quick attendee list and roles. Can your ops team confirm what we need for the live demo (VPC access, S3 sample dataset, temporary creds)?

Elena
Sr. Alliances Manager
QuantumLift Systems
(attachment: quantumlift_attendees.csv)

---
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena@quantumlift.com>, AWS SI - Partner Ops <aws-partner-coordinator@amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Jul 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Redwood x QuantumLift — co-sell listing + demo request

Thanks Elena — looping in ops and our marketplace lead. Vanessa, Karthik — can you take ops lead on requirements? Specific asks from QuantumLift: short inference run (1–2 min), sample dataset (~10k tokens), and a 15-minute troubleshooting block for SI.

Iattached our internal co-sell runbook (cosell_runbook_v2.pdf) — please confirm the items weshould validate before the run (network egress, STS role with S3 read, and a KV cache warmup plan). Also, if AWS needs any pre-approvals for SI access, ping me and Ill handle the contact.

Mina
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
(attachment: cosell_runbook_v2.pdf)

---
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <elena@quantumlift.com>, AWS SI - Partner Ops <aws-partner-coordinator@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Jul 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed agenda + times (draft)

Quick schedule draft — Ive blocked three slots across the week to cover timezones. If AWS SI is only available in the afternoon PT, we can do a staggered approach: short pre-brief for SI + extended demo for QuantumLift customers.

Draft agenda (45–60 min):
- 0:00–0:05 Introductions (partner + Redwood + AWS SI)
- 0:05–0:20 Marketplace listing walkthrough (listing page, copy, collateral)
- 0:20–0:35 Live inference demo (sample dataset; 1 prod-like request)
- 0:35–0:50 Ops Q&A (network reqs, perms, runbook)
- 0:50–0:60 Next steps & mutual action items

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue Jul 25, 10:00–11:00 (primary)
- Wed Jul 26, 14:00–15:00 (backup)
- Thu Jul 27, 08:30–09:30 (EMEA alternative)

I attached a proposed agenda PDF and will create a calendar invite once we pick a slot. Vanessa
Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
(attachment: proposed-agenda.pdf)

---
From: AWS SI - Partner Ops <aws-partner-coordinator@amazon.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@quantumlift.com>, Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Jul 2028 15:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed agenda + times (AWS SI availability)

Hi all,

Thanks for the agenda. Quick heads up: our SI lead (Samir) has a customer blackout on Tue Jul 25 morning and cannot join the primary slot. We can join Wed Jul 26 14:00–15:00 PT, or Thu Jul 27 08:30–09:30 PT, but not Tue. If you prefer the Tuesday slot, we can still do a two-part cadence: a 20-minute pre-brief with the SI later that day and the full demo with QuantumLift on Wed.

Also, please confirm whether the demo needs VPC peering or if an S3 signed URL + temporary role will suffice. If VPC peering is required, well need network contact details and a security contact to run the checklist.

-AWS Partner Ops
(attachment: network-checklist.txt)

---
From: Elena Torres <elena@quantumlift.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, AWS SI - Partner Ops <aws-partner-coordinator@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 27 Jul 2028 09:36:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed agenda + times (confirming AWS conflict)

Thanks Samir (cc). Were flexible — if AWS wants the Wed 14:00 slot, that works fine. However, to avoid losing attendees in APAC, would Redwood consider splitting the demo into: a 30-minute customer-facing demo (recorded) + a 30-minute technical run-through (internal + SI) the following day? That would let us keep the marketplace webinar time tight and still get SI sign-off on runbook items.

If thats acceptable, Ill update the attendee list and we can send a calendar invite for two linked events.

Elena

---
From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena@quantumlift.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, AWS SI - Partner Ops <aws-partner-coordinator@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Jul 2028 16:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QuantumLift — Redwood + AWS co-sell / staggered marketplace demo

Elena — that split makes a lot of sense. Heres the proposed plan:

1) Customer-facing session (recorded): Wed Jul 26, 14:00–14:30 PT — short marketplace tour + 20-min demo. Public-facing invite; marketing will use recording.
2) Technical session (SI + internal): Thu Jul 27, 09:00–09:45 PT — deep dive run-of-show, credentials, network checklist, and TROUBLESHOOT block.

Action items:
- Vanessa: create two linked calendar events and include the runbook link in invites.
- Karthik / Ops: confirm whether VPC peering is required by EOD Mon Jul 31; if not, prepare signed S3 URLs and a temporary STS role.
- Elena: share final attendee list and any sample dataset links (S3 or sample files) by EOD Mon Jul 31.

Ive created a shared drive folder for the run-of-show and added the cosell_runbook_v2.pdf. Adding HubSpot deal record for tracking: https://hubspot.company/QL-2345

See you all on Wed.

Mina Haddad
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com
(attachments referenced: cosell_runbook_v2.pdf, quantumlift_attendees.csv)
